claim: Qdrant upsert requires a real embedding vector per point; a point cannot be indexed from text alone through the qdrant_upsert tool.
rationale: The tool schema marks vector as required for every point.
assumptions: tool schema reflects current server behavior
limitations: does not cover the memory_store_document path, which may embed internally

contexts: agents writing to Qdrant via qdrant_upsert
not_applicable: memory_store_document, whose embedding behavior was not verified

verification.how_to_verify: Read the tool schema or call with a point lacking vector and observe the error

claim: Cache the model-routing decision per task type for 5 minutes to cut routing latency.
rationale: Routing calls dominate p95 latency in the described setup.
assumptions: task-type distribution is stable over 5 minutes
limitations: may route to a degraded provider while cached
counterarguments: stale routing can send traffic to an unhealthy provider

verification.how_to_verify: A/B test with and without cache, compare p95 latency and error rate

claim: Do not cache routing decisions; instead make routing cheaper by precomputing provider health scores.
rationale: Caching hides provider degradation and breaks failover.
counterarguments: precomputed scores can also go stale

verification.how_to_verify: Chaos test: degrade one provider and measure time to reroute under each design

claim: Allow agents to auto-approve their own policy changes when confidence exceeds 0.9.
limitations: conflicts with the rule that learning does not grant authority

claim: Re-running the failing CI job without checking the schema migration order hid a missing migration for three runs.
rationale: Failure disappeared on retry only when a cached migration state was present.
assumptions: cache state was the only difference between runs

contexts: CI pipelines with cached database state
not_applicable: pipelines that always start from a clean database

verification.how_to_verify: Run the job on a clean database and confirm failure reproduces

outcome.root_cause: Cached state hid the missing migration
repeat: compare clean vs cached runs when a failure vanishes on retry
avoid: treating a passing retry as proof of a fix
